title: US M2 money supply rises $103B in July to $23.2T, hitting a new all-time high
summary:
Rising M2 money supply may fuel market optimism, easing credit conditions and encouraging risk-taking, impacting equities and crypto.
The post US M2 money supply rises $103B in July to $23.2T, hitting a new all-time high appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The United States M2 money supply increased by $103 billion in July, reaching a new all-time high of $23.2 trillion. This expansion in the money supply could potentially boost market optimism, ease credit conditions, and encourage risk-taking behaviors, which may have notable implications for both equities and cryptocurrency markets moving forward.

title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
summary: This latest U.S. appeals court ruling sets up a rift between federal courts on event contracts, suggesting the U.S. Supreme Court may need to settle the matter.

This appeals court decision creates a significant divide among federal courts regarding event contracts. title: Market Analyst Eyes $200,000 Bitcoin Target As Monthly Chart Flashes Bullish Signal

content: Bitcoin remained relatively subdued after a turbulent week in the broader cryptocurrency market, yet analysts are keeping their eyes on a potential two hundred thousand dollar target as the monthly chart flashes bullish signals. title: Iran’s crude oil exports near zero as US targets banking networks with Operation Economic Outcast
summary:
The US sanctions on Iran's oil exports could destabilize global oil markets and strain Iran's economy, impacting regional geopolitics.
The post Iran’s crude oil exports near zero as US targets banking networks with Operation Economic Outcast appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Iran's crude oil exports have dropped to near zero as the United States intensifies pressure through Operation Economic Outcast. By targeting key banking networks, these sanctions aim to heavily restrict Iran's financial capabilities. Analysts warn that these measures could significantly strain the regional economy and have potential ripple effects on global oil markets, escalating geopolitical tensions.
